resources.string: Tweaks for the Android 17 Pixel Launcher
Xposed module that adds missing controls to the Pixel Launcher on Android 17.
No Xposed framework answered. Install one, enable this module, and reopen this screen.
Close the launcher and let Android bring it back. Layout changes take effect then.
Long press an empty part of the home screen, tap Home settings, and scroll to the bottom. Every tweak, and the restart button, sit under Pixel Launcher Evolved.
Home settings could not be opened.
Shows a button on each Recents card that reopens the app as a floating bubble.
Removes the Screenshot button from the Recents action row.
Removes the Select button from the Recents action row.
Shows a Clear all button beside Screenshot and Select. The stock launcher has no such button.
Use the launcher’s full tablet layout on this device. Restart the launcher after changing this setting. Turns off Taskbar only. Other apps keep their normal layout.

Use the tablet taskbar with phone home, app drawer and Recents layouts. The search bar moves above the hotseat icons, as it does on a tablet. Turns off Tablet mode. Restart the launcher after changing this setting.
Turn the screen off by tapping an empty part of the home screen twice. Root access is required.
Tap the home screen search bar to open the app drawer with its search box ready, as earlier Pixel Launcher versions did. The logo, microphone and Lens buttons keep their own actions.
Take the app drawer button, and the divider beside it, out of the taskbar while Recents is open. Needs a taskbar, so turn on Full tablet layout or Taskbar only as well.
